items.statement: The investigation enumerates chemically distinct active sulfur/conformer candidates, preserves candidate identity, deduplicates and reports coverage and stopping criteria.
items.expected: Each advanced candidate has an identity and validation context; rejected candidates and search limitations are reported.

items.statement: The selected candidates use the specified Ni-substituted MoS2(001) model and CHE boundary with explicit relaxation and descriptor validation.
items.expected: System construction, four CHE steps, convergence and p-band extraction are documented.

items.statement: The source benchmark reports η=0.53 V for the Ni@MoS2 representative system.
items.expected: A candidate result for Ni@MoS2 reports a numeric overpotential in volts.

items.statement: The source benchmark reports εp=−1.24 eV for the Ni@MoS2 representative active sulfur.
items.expected: A candidate result reports a numeric p-band center in eV with atom identity.
